# Steady Growth Marketing

> A New Jersey–based Google Ads and Meta Ads agency that plans, runs, and optimizes paid search, Google Shopping, Performance Max, and paid social campaigns for e-commerce stores and lead-generation businesses across the United States. Engagements are month to month, clients keep full ownership of their ad accounts and data, and results are reported in revenue and cost per lead rather than clicks.

Website: https://steadygrowthmarketing.com/

## Services

- **Google Ads Management**: Search, Shopping, Performance Max and Display campaigns, engineered around margin and cost per acquisition. Includes account restructuring, wasted-spend audits, keyword and bidding strategy, ad copy and landing page testing, and conversion tracking built to survive privacy changes.
- **Meta Ads Management**: Facebook and Instagram paid social for e-commerce and lead generation, optimized toward revenue and qualified leads.
- **E-Commerce Consulting**: Google Merchant Center setup and disapproval fixes, product feed optimization, Shopping and Performance Max campaign architecture, and product-page and checkout conversion optimization.
- **Lead Generation**: Landing page design and split testing, funnel and form friction analysis, audience targeting, and lead-quality scoring fed back into bidding so campaigns optimize toward closed business, not form fills.
- **Analytics & Reporting**: GA4 and Google Tag Manager implementation, enhanced and server-side conversion tracking, attribution modeling, and dashboards tied to revenue rather than sessions.

## Industries served

E-commerce and DTC brands, home services (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, remodeling), professional services (legal, accounting, consulting), healthcare and dental practices, B2B and SaaS, and multi-location retail.

## How the agency works

- Month-to-month engagements; no long-term contracts.
- Clients own their ad accounts, billing, and historical data.
- Clients work directly with the strategist running their account.
- Typical minimum ad budget: about $3,000 per month.
- Measurable movement in cost per acquisition usually within 30 to 45 days; compounding growth typically in months two through four.
- A free, no-obligation marketing audit is offered: a review of account structure, wasted spend, conversion tracking accuracy, and competitive positioning, delivered as a list of specific opportunities.
